title: fix(plugin-form): an ObjectForm block's showReset draws the Reset button instead of clearing the form after a save
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgP6XkfpjCfyzzG2KwQPUZfy)_
Fixes #27247

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：ObjectForm 区块的 `showReset: true` 现在会在表单按钮栏画出「重置」按钮，点了把表单恢复到打开时的值、不保存；保存后不再因为 `showReset` 清空表单。
- **为什么改**：规范把 `showReset` 写作「显示重置按钮」，渲染器却把它当成「保存后清空」：设 `true` 没按钮、每次保存清空表单，设 `false` 没作用。
- **风险与回滚**：依赖旧的「保存后清空」副作用的表单会不再清空（应改用 `submitBehavior: { kind: 'continue' }`）；回滚即 revert 本 PR，无数据或协议迁移。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`（按钮与 reset 事件处理）、`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx`（去掉 OR 进 `resetOnSubmit` 的那行）、`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx`（表单外的页脚按钮经表单 id 触发重置）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.showReset-27247.test.tsx`，预期 8 条全过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The `object-form` block declares `showReset` as "Show the reset button" (the spec text is unchanged). The renderer OR-ed it into the form's clear-after-save flag, so `true` drew no button and emptied the form after every save, and `false` did nothing. The triage ruling: the renderer honours `showReset` as declared, and `resetOnSubmit` stays its own key.

- **`@object-ui/components` (`form` renderer).** `showReset` draws a Reset button in the action bar, between Cancel and Save, labelled `resetLabel` or the session language's `common.reset` (already in all ten packs; added to the no-provider fallback). The `form` element handles its own `reset` event: it restores react-hook-form's opening values (the defaults the `defaultValues` reset keeps current), clears the submit error and the rejected-field markers, and calls `preventDefault` so the browser does not also restore the DOM inputs. So any `type="reset"` button that names the form's `id` reaches the same restore.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-form`.**
  - `ObjectForm`: the flat path no longer reads `showReset` into `resetOnSubmit`. The flat and sectioned simple paths hand `showReset` (off in `view` mode) to the bar.
  - `TabbedForm` forwards it to its bar.
  - `DrawerForm` and `ModalForm` draw the button in their own footers as `type="reset" form={formId}`, gated like Save (no button in `view` mode or on a record closed for edit). A footer with only Reset still shows.
- **`@object-ui/types`.** `FormSchema` (the renderer-internal `form` node, which `@objectstack/spec` does not declare) gains `showReset?: boolean` and `resetLabel?: string`, with JSDoc and zod rows. The seat approved this file-surface addition before any push.

**Not covered (no clean slot).** `WizardForm` and `MasterDetailForm` have their own action bars. A wizard has one inner form per step plus merged step data, and a master-detail form has a header form plus line items, so neither has one form whose opening values a Reset restores. Both still read no `showReset`, and nothing there changes.

**Declarations, measured.** `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: the two keys reach the published entry of `@object-ui/types` (`dist/form.d.ts` declares `showReset?: boolean` and `resetLabel?: string` on the exported `FormSchema`; `dist/zod/form.zod.d.ts` has both rows). `Metadata-protocol: none`: what a metadata author writes is unchanged. The `object-form` block's `showReset` and its text are as before, and the new keys sit on the `form` node, which is not in the spec's block vocabulary or the public-tier `sdui.manifest.json` (`check-sdui-manifest` exit 0, manifest unchanged). Changeset level `patch` for the three packages.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.showReset-27247.test.tsx` (8): the flat form's button restores `initialValues` and does not call `create`; a save with `showReset: true` keeps the typed value (the pin against the old clear); unset draws no button; `view` mode draws none; the sectioned form restores the opening values; the tabbed form draws one button; the modal footer's button names the form's `id` and a click restores the opening values; the drawer footer draws it with the form's `id`.
- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-reset-button-27247.test.tsx` (3): no button unless `showReset`; `resetLabel` names it and a click restores `defaultValues` without `onSubmit`; a reset button outside the form reaches it through the form `id`.

<details><summary>Ablations (each committed first, mutated through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to HEAD with git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- Put `schema.showReset ||` back at the head of the flat path's `resetOnSubmit`: `a save does not clear the form because of showReset` goes red, 1 failed and 7 passed.
- Delete `onReset={handleReset}` from the `form` element: 5 red (restores the opening values; outside reset button; flat form; sectioned form; modal footer), 6 passed.

</details>

<details><summary>Local verification (pre-merge head 42f88315, merged head 61baeb31)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-form/ packages/components/src/renderers/form/ packages/types/`: pre-merge 674 files passed, 13326 tests passed, 18 skipped; post-merge 676 files passed, 13337 tests passed, 18 skipped.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`: exit 0 on both heads.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` (34 families) run on the merged head and reconciled with `--ran`: 34 derived, 34 run, every one exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/ui/components/plugins.mdx` lists `showReset` with no description. That page is generated from `sdui.manifest.json`, from the `object-form` registration inputs in `plugin-form/src/index.tsx`. Adding a description there means regenerating the manifest and the page, which is outside this card's file surface, so it is left as is. The ui README and `content/docs/**` have no sentence that describes the old effect.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` says "Show the reset button." for `showReset`. That is now true, so no skills line is wrong.
- Found while measuring, for the seat to file: on the sectioned simple path, `ObjectForm` builds its `form` node without `resetOnSubmit`. So `submitBehavior: { kind: 'continue' }` (and `resetOnSuccess` on a create form) does not clear a sectioned form after a save, while the flat form does. A probe test reproduced this: the flat form cleared, the sectioned form kept `Alpha`.
- The merge commit from `origin/main` carries no trailer pair (git's default merge message; the pre-push hook accepted it).

## Verification

Open an `object-form` block with `showReset: true` in create mode, type in a field, and press Reset. The field goes back to its opening value and nothing is saved. Save, and the form keeps the saved values.
